# Concepts

**Where you are:** [Reading root](../../../README.md) › [#4 Episteme](../../../symbolon/episteme/README.md) › Concepts

Concepts holds the controlled distinctions the argument repeatedly consumes. After T09 the canonical semantic identity surface is **C01–C64**:

- [[CANONICAL-INDEX|Canonical Concept Index — C01–C64]]
- [Canonical Arguments — A01–A36](../README.md)
- [A ↔ C ↔ E Reciprocity Index](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/T09-A-C-E-RECIPROCITY-INDEX.md)

Each C-ID page gives a positive definition, the reason the distinction exists, its operation and consequence, neighbours/conjugates, Argument and Movement consumers, load-bearing Etymology relation, source/tradition standing, carrier disposition, unresolved delta and Depth Restoration status.

A Concept is an Episteme record, not a Matheme, Mytheme or Symbolon root. It institutes a reusable distinction; it does not derive a formal operation, perform a whole imaginal scene or claim historical warrant it does not possess.

## Reconciliation (ticket 036, 2026-09-25)

The folder now holds exactly the canonical field: **C01–C64**, this README, `CANONICAL-INDEX.md`, and `j-space.md`. The pre-T09 `index.md` (transverse-braid Concept Map) was retired after its still-live links were repointed, and the 21 loose topic files (`agentworld.md`, `anthropomorphization.md`, `apoha.md`, `bimba-pratibimba.md`, `centaur-societies.md`, `compassion-as-sensitivity-to-origins.md`, `counterfeit-gathering.md`, `diaphaneity.md`, `dimensional-reframing-at-zero-and-infinity.md`, `fusion-as-syns-shadow.md`, `mathematical-artistic-image-register.md`, `parasociety.md`, `planetary-computation.md`, `prompt-thrownness.md`, `psychoid-number.md`, `register-grammar.md`, `simulation.md`, `the-slash.md`, `vikalpa-samkalpa.md`, `world-picture-to-world-atlas.md`, `zero.md`) were verified against the C-field and retired to `working/_to_delete/2026-09-25-retire/loose-concepts/` — nothing deleted; the per-file disposition table (canonical carrier and absorbed points) is in the `## ticket 036` section of `working/_to_delete/2026-09-25-retire/MANIFEST.md` and in `.wayfinder/research/036-loose-concepts-report.md`.
